A clothing brand. Its tagline asks for two opposites in one look: Controlled Unstable Looks.

Brand idea

One trick, twice. One shape, two readings — control holding instability.

Both concepts below are part of the final identity. The cube is the mark. The T is the wordmark.

Concept

Two shapes, same idea.

A cube that is made to fall

A cube.The most stable form there is.
N + E.Front face: N. Top face: E.
Look again.Top and side together: a man, about to fall.
Two readings.Cube: control. Man: instability.

A letter that is also the garment

One T.Shared by neutron and electron.
A t-shirt.The letter is the product.
An umbrella.The umbrella is the control — the two words, the instability.
On the garment.The name wears the product.

Logo system

The mark, up close. The wordmark, in colour.
